# Devdog Sci-Fi UI

This folder contains the imported uGUI assets used by the MoonRover HUD.

- Source: https://github.com/devdogio/sci-fi-ui
- License: MIT (see `DevdogSciFiUI.LICENSE`)
- General helper source: Devdog General, pinned to the revision referenced by the Sci-Fi UI package (see `General.LICENSE`)

The active project UI is generated by `Assets/Editor/UISetupWizard.cs`. The imported package is kept under `Assets/ThirdParty` so it can be updated or removed without mixing third-party files with project scripts.
